name: Sovyrian-Born
text: **Sovyrian-Born**: Elves who come from the ancient elven civilization of Sovyrian are steeped in lore older than most civilizations. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Knowledge (history), Knowledge (local), and Spellcraft checks. This racial trait replaces elven magic and keen senses.
